correction_to_batch_064: Batch 064 misnamed two recap thumbnails before their labels appeared. findings.text: 05_9 recap grid (148.6 s on, held to at least 152.7 s): the second-row labels (sin z, Gamma(z), zeta(s)) are squeezed into the gap between the rows. Measured on sheet 0206 slot 4 (tile rows): the upper thumbnail ends at row 253, the 'sin z' ink spans rows 258-267 and the lower thumbnail starts at row 273, so each label is 4 px from the picture above and 5 px from its own; the first-row labels sit 13 px above their pictures with nothing below them. A glance can read 'sin z' as the caption of the z^3 - 1 picture just above it. Pairing is still decidable from the labels-above pattern. Suggest moving the second row down (or the labels up into a wider gap) so each label is clearly closer to its own thumbnail.
